reviews.text: Excellent service
I was on school holidays in Porto when I found a pigeon that didn't look very well. I took it to the vet; they treated it very well, it was inexpensive, and everyone was very kind.
Very good and attentive service.

Do not use the services of this clinic.
In two separate cases, we left parrots of the same species in the care of the establishment, and in both situations, the same thing happened: the animals ended up dying the day after being admitted. They did not ask for our consent regarding the procedures during the "treatment," we were not informed of the protocols, and what they did not hesitate to share with us was the bill, always expensive despite the care being, in general, useless.
We might have assumed that the animals' illnesses would be difficult to care for and treat, being exotic species; however, in the second case, the parrot had injuries caused by its companion, which should have required simpler care and therefore a higher success rate than we had already experienced. We were wrong.
In addition to being expensive, it does not produce results.
It is an excellent place to go... if you intend to euthanize your animals.
Their focus is solely on profits and not on patients, leading me and my family, who are still mourning the deaths of our animals, to question the level of specialization and professionalism of the workers.

Please do not leave your animals hospitalized here without clear and prior information about what this entails. This is not a health establishment dedicated to animal welfare, but a business that, in my experience, seemed focused on maximizing profit — that's the impression I get, without being able to prove it, but it's the only interpretation I can give to the facts I experienced.
In decades of experience taking animals to veterinarians, it was the first time that medical procedures were performed without my explicit knowledge or consent. I had a very old, sick domestic laying hen. I was told that there was no availability for a consultation due to the overload of service, and that the only way to have her seen was through hospitalization — obviously more expensive. I didn't understand the logic, I didn't like the indication that this imposition suggested, but I had no alternative: it was Saturday, and the seriousness of the situation was evident even to a layperson. I left the hen hospitalized.
During the hospitalization, no contact was made to ask for my consent before any procedure. They didn't even ask me for basic information about the animal — age, whether it was a pet or a laying hen, whether it belonged to a flock. Clinical decisions with associated costs were made without consulting me.
Today they called me to inform me that it had died, and only then did they describe what had been done — information that reached me after everything was decided and completed, when it was no longer useful for me to have given my opinion or decided otherwise.
They are a disgrace to the profession. I hope that one day animal health will be taken seriously enough for there to be real scrutiny of these practices. May the unnecessary prolongation of the suffering of an innocent animal (and others, I imagine) feel good about you.
It was my first time visiting, they were very attentive.
I do not recommend this clinic.

Wonderful experience, they were super attentive to Oliver, a 4-month-old cockatiel. We went there for a health check-up and preventative care. Professionals willing to answer questions and provide information to preserve the health of our pets, plus they have affordable prices! I highly recommend the place and the professionals!
Make your appointment!

I was hesitant to give such a bad rating, but after two emergency visits and several calls to them, and seeing the animal's condition, I think it's reasonable.

Our guinea pig was crying when he urinated, so we decided to take him to the center. We knew he had excess calcium, but we weren't sure if he had kidney stones. The vet did an x-ray and didn't see anything in his bladder or kidneys. The problem starts here; she prescribed antibiotics, antispasmodics (for colic, which can cause constipation), analgesics, and anti-inflammatories... quite a cocktail... We were a bit apprehensive, but she assured us the doses were safe...

The next day, the animal urinated blood (we thought it was because he released the remaining calcium), but from then on, he started having irregular bowel movements. We called and they told us to continue with the medication... Two days later, seeing no improvement, we took him to another veterinarian who advised us to stop everything except the antibiotics and anti-inflammatories and start giving him something to speed up the intestinal tract because his intestines weren't working...

The following week, we had to go to the emergency room because the animal was still swollen... The on-call veterinarian didn't see anything unusual and prescribed analgesics and did a urine test (where we didn't find any infection)... The next day we took him to our regular veterinarian who, after doing another X-ray, said the animal had a swollen stomach and would have to start defecating or it could die...

We are trying to treat him to get his intestines back to normal (already lacking intestinal flora due to an unnecessary antibiotic) and the antispasmodic that basically stopped the animal's intestines...

We hope the guinea pig survives, but we went in with an animal that only had a little discomfort when urinating and now we have an animal that isn't eating, is... Swollen and could die.... We spent more than 3 weeks trying to save the animal, which is in "critical care" and is still not stable...

I don't know if it was coincidence, bad luck, veterinary error, or a combination of other factors, but now, at least for me, I no longer trust them for guinea pigs since my experience was not at all positive.
Be careful when leaving animals for hospitalization because they charge a lot for medication, and they knew my animal wouldn't survive, yet they let it drag on for 8 days.
A very dedicated team.
Excellent professional who took care of my chinchilla! I highly recommend him!
Attentive and professional. I recommend them.

Terrible weekend emergency service for those who own birds of prey! I took an owl with a dislocation, and first they gave me a quote, then they said it would be double to put the leg back in place! I arrived at the vet with the owl at 10:30 am and picked it up at 4 pm without them having put the leg back in place because they didn't have qualified veterinarians on site to perform the procedure!
The owl was there for less than 24 hours, and they charged me as if it had been there for 24 hours.
I left with the owl without the leg in place, and I received a terrible photo of the X-ray by email, which I had already paid for!
In short, I paid over €100 to leave with the owl in the same condition!
It should be noted that the veterinarian who was at the clinic that day even had the audacity to say that they were the only exotic animal veterinarians open on Sundays. At least they would be honest and say right away that they didn't have veterinarians qualified to treat birds of prey or perform the procedure!
Because of this, I had to go to another vet the next day to resolve the situation, and with this waiting time, the owl's leg became swollen.
With all this, I just want to say that I do not recommend this exotic bird clinic for birds of prey.
Very professional and attentive!!!
Good professionals, good service.
Good service,

10/10 You can trust them 100%

I went from Braga to Porto early on a Saturday morning for an emergency, as my rabbit hadn't eaten for 24 hours. They answered my call and were immediately very approachable and understanding, and they quickly arranged several options for my rabbit to be treated.

On the first day, I was greeted by a super friendly, very informative and professional veterinarian. This immediately gave me a huge sense of confidence in the establishment.

My rabbit was hospitalized for a few days; it was my first experience with my rabbit so far away from me, but I felt very reassured, as they answered or forwarded all my calls, gave a lot of details about how PomPom Purin was behaving and how everything was going (all the nurses and doctors were extremely attentive and detail-oriented).

Today I picked him up, the veterinarian was super informative about what I had to do now at this stage and was super, super kind.

In addition to my praise for the veterinarians, I also want to commend the nurses who were always very proactive, and thank the young woman who attended to me early on a Saturday morning and expedited PomPom Purin's care.

I was in a desperate situation and felt that my rabbit and I were very well received.

I am immensely grateful to the entire medical team for helping my rabbit and for being so attentive to me.

Keep up the good work and the love for your profession, which is evident in your eyes.

Purino (nickname) returned home looking very healthy. Thank you so much for helping him.
Very helpful and excellent care!
I was received very warmly and my birds were very well cared for, I will always come back!
Top team for Exotic Animals, they know what they're doing and are gentle with the animals.
Very good service

It's the best hospital.

Very competent doctors, nurses, and assistants.

I recommend it.
They took very good care of my bird.
Friendliness, attentiveness, and utmost professionalism.

This team treated my guinea pig very well, they were very attentive and friendly.

Thank you.
Friendly, humane service, very attentive and dedicated.
The usual quality and efficiency. Top-notch medical team.

I took my tenrec to the clinic for a consultation; she was barely eating anything, and her hind legs were weak, so she was admitted. Despite not eating much, she was in a very good mood and was always trying to climb on me. …
It's awful, they don't know how to treat animals, they just fill them with pointless medications.
Good professionals. Friendly and dedicated.
Excellent follow-up and genuine care for our animals. It's wonderful to have a trustworthy place where everyone who has worked with my animal has been an exceptional professional. Thank you.
